sense: the game played with cues on a table

terms.comment: tudicula is classically a small machine for crushing olives (Columella, by Lewis & Short); the name for the game is Traupman’s.

phrases.latin: globulōs eburneōs clāvā tudiculārī super mēnsam impellere

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 362.
